lines.en: A couple of us are helping Molly move into her new dorm room today.
Tsuneyo wound up getting permission from her father to spend some nights here, so the two of them are going to be the first pair to move into the second floor of the dorms.
Well, at least the second floor allotted to my students.
Apparently, I inherited the “misfit” class.
Not because they’re actually misfits themselves, but because nearly every other girl in their grade is housed in the building directly next to this one.
Don’t ask me for an explanation as to why, though. I literally have no idea.
: How long do you think it’s been up there?
Ahh, and speaking of things that require an explanation, allow me to show you something-
: Who knows? It seems pretty content, though.
: You think so? It looks scared to me.
: How? It’s literally just standing there.
: Yeah, but he’s out of his natural habitat! What would you do if you were used to living outside and then had to move into a girls’ dormitory?
: Celebrate.
: Yeah...well, you’re stupid. I say we rescue the bird.
: How? You can’t even reach it.
: No, but you can.
: I’m not going to touch the bird. It probably has diseases or something.
: Maybe you should touch it then.
: Oh hey, Maya. I must have forgotten you were there since I haven’t been insulted in over two minutes.
: I’m tired. I have to save my insults for when they’ll make the most impact.
: If you’re tired then why are you here? Shouldn’t you go downstairs and take a nap or something?
: It’s too late in the day to nap. I’d just fall asleep for the entire night.
: Besides...Molly is technically a friend of mine and it would be rude for me to not assist given the circumstances.
: What circumstances?
: Being alone with you.
: That sounds terrifying and I don't want to subject her to that.
: You’re alone with me all the time.
: Not willingly.
: Can you two stop fighting for a second and help me restore order to nature?
: Jeez, all I wanna do is save the poor little birdie and you guys feel the need to remind each other of your hate for one another.
: Give it a rest already. We get it.
: I don’t hate Maya at all.
: He’s right. I’m the one who hates him. Please keep him away from me.
: Ugh. Whatever, I’ll just figure out how to save it on my own.
: Go help Rin with boxes or something, Sensei.
: Oh, right. We’re supposed to be moving things.
: Kill me...
: Hey, Rin. What’s the problem?
: So many boxes. So little strength.
: Here, let me take a few of those from you. I have a strange amount of experience when it comes to carrying boxes out of the dorm.
: No can do, Master! There is a strict no-boys-allowed policy when it comes to my personal belongings.
: Ignoring that would cause your hands to turn black and fall off!
: Then why am I even here?
: Because you’re the protagonist! This is a scripted event that must occur if I’m ever to become the lead heroine!
: Wait, you’re shooting for the lead? The chuuni character never gets the lead role. You should know this.
: That’s not true. Rikka got the lead in the Chuunibyou series.
: That one literally has Chuunibyou in the title. That doesn't count.
: What the fuck are you two even talking about?
: Oh, sorry! Time for another weebnote!
: Awesome. I’m sure all of our imaginary fans will love this.
: Chuunibyou is the term given to the behavior of characters who act in overdramatic and often embarrassing ways!
: You mean like how you act literally every day?
: Exactly like that! It’s what makes me lovable and you will come to appreciate it in due time, Sir.
: Come to think of it, didn’t you say something in class about how Rin was like...the commander of the undead or something?
: Does she have this chuunibyou thing, too?
: N-N-Not as bad as Molly has it! I'm just a normal dork who does dorky things! It's not bad enough to label it with an actual condition!
: You have fallen just as far into the darkness as I have and you know it.
: I have not! And stop bringing up my secret life when we’re not in the club room anymore! I’m begging you!
: Everywhere is a club room when you are unable to exhibit self-control.
: But I guess there are more pressing matters at hand right now. Right, Captain?
: Captain. Master. Sensei. Sir. Can you just pick one already, Molly?
: I have too many names now and it’s confusing me.
: Sir yes, Sir. You will henceforth be known as Supreme Overlord Sensei, Herald of the Adolescents.
That’s somehow even worse than having four names.
: Molly, come to think of it, how come you’re making Rin carry all of your stuff?
: We came all the way here to help you out, but I don’t think I’ve seen you actually do anything so far.
: I can assure you that there is a perfectly acceptable reason for that.
: Okay...And what’s the reason?
: You see...I expelled the majority of my power during a fight with an ancient wizard earlier today and am now only able to use 5%% of my total strength.
: You said your reason was acceptable. I’ve been deceived.
: Okay, fine. I am very weak, Sir.
: My fragile Irish arms can’t even carry a sack o’ potatoes up the stairs.
: Why would you ever need to do that?...
: I thought the Irish were supposed to be tough? You know...that whole fightin’ Irish stereotype and whatnot.
: Sir, this may come as a shock to you, but I don’t go outside all that much.
: That doesn't come as a shock at all, actually.
: The result of my inability to exercise has, for lack of a better term- turned my muscles into mashed potatoes.
: Are you really going to make potato references every chance you get?
: Probably, Supreme Overlord. That is simply the person I am.
: Oh, speaking of potatoes, do you still want to come bathing suit shopping with Futaba and me tomorrow?
: What does that have to do with potatoes?
: Nothing. I just need to know because I was supposed to respond to Futaba like half an hour ago.
: Oh, umm...yeah. I can come, I guess.
: Are you not looking forward to the beach, Molly? That’s not really the excited sort of reaction I’d expect out of someone like you.
: To be quite frank, Sir, I am utterly horrified. I’m not even sure if I’m going to survive this trip.
: That seems a little extreme.
: Supreme Overlord, take a good, long look at my body and tell me what you see.
: For the record, Molly...it would probably be best to, like...not ask Sensei things like that.
At least Rin understands me.
: Tell me, Supreme Overlord. Is this the body of someone who looks like she would fare well under the intense Kumon-mi sun?
: I will be a lobster in less than five minutes.
: I don’t even know how to swim.
: Then what the hell are you going to do at the beach?
: Make memories that only girls my age are able to make! Live life to the fullest! Find the man who killed my father and avenge him!
: Your dad is still alive, though...
: That seems like a lot to do in one weekend.
: Thankfully, the backup plan is reading manga under an umbrella.
: That sounds a lot more realistic.
: But if you’re looking for something a little more...beach-oriented, I could always teach you how to swim.
: I...will respectfully decline! I am perfectly happy not knowing how to swim!
: How are you that red already, Molly?...
: Irish skin! It reveals our true emotions even when we don’t want it to!
: Are you really that embarrassed thinking about Sensei teaching you how to swim?
: Of course! That’s like, straight out of a dating-sim. I’m not yet prepared.
: You know you're never going to be the lead heroine with that attitude, right?
: I need to go set more things up in my room!
Molly quickly vanishes into her dorm and I’m left in the hall with Rin and the others.
: She is certainly a character.
: That’s an understatement. Molly lives in a world of her own.
: You'd think that with all the raunchy manga and h-games she plays that she'd be able to talk about touching another human without getting flushed, but...nope.
: She straight up can't even talk about romance without getting like that either. It's wild.
: Speaking of romance, are you excited to see Chika in a swimsuit?
: I’m going to actually die.
: Do you have the hospital on speed dial? Because if not, you should definitely get on that.
: Sure. Just for you, though. If anyone else asks me to call an ambulance, they’ll be shit out of luck.
: That’s kind of a horrible thing to say.
: I’m kind of a horrible person.
: The best horrible person.
Rin holds out her fist to me, expecting a fist bump.
Instead of immediately reciprocating, which is what my heart tells me to do, I am faced with a troubling question.
: If I pound it right now, does that doom me to a life in the friend-zone?
: Are you implying you’re not already in the friend-zone?
: I sure hope not.
: Flirting with me is a bold move when you know for a fact that I am undressing Chika with my mind right now.
: Are you doing anything else at literally any point in your daily life?
: Only if another cute girl walks by. But then I default back to Chika the second they're gone.
: Yeah, I guess that makes sense.
: Finish the fist bump, Sensei. These boxes are heavier than they look and you are leaving me hanging.
I bump Rin's fist, regardless of any possible consequences.
: Welcome to the friend-zone, bud.
: Don’t you fucking dare.
: Oh, come on! You know I’m kidding. We’re already more than just friends in my eyes.
: That's right. We're homies.
: Ahh!
: Say it again! One more time!
: We're homies.
: One more! One more!
: ...Homies.
: Yes...YES!
: I can feel my strength returning!
: To think that I'd be so easily swayed by hearing the words I have waited so long to hear!
: Excuse me, Sensei...But I must make use of this new found strength.
: Until we meet again!
Rin tries to open the door to Molly’s room but is unable to due to the amount of boxes she’s carrying.
As such, I help push it open for her and she disappears inside...
: How are you doing over here, Ami?
: I can’t reach the bird and Maya won’t help.
: Just leave it alone...
: I’m with Maya on this. Just leave it alone. That bird lives here now.
: Give me five more minutes with it.
Five minutes soon becomes half an hour as Rin and I carry the rest of Molly’s stuff upstairs.
Thankfully, after arguing with her about it for a minute or two, Molly caved on her ‘no-boys’ policy and allowed me to actually help.
And even though I’m not the type to normally go out of his way to be kind like this, it is a little fun helping her move in.
Especially knowing that I’ll be able to visit her sometime in the near future-
And how determined she is to become a heroine...
Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!
